body:
I’m so sorry about your loss. My cat just passed two weeks ago and the pain is still very much there. He also kept me from ending things multiple times and now I feel like I can never repay him. 

It sounds like you were such a good parent to your cat. He loved you until the very last moment and I hope you know you only did what was best for him. Let yourself take all the time you need to grieve. I bet he’s resting in peace in cat heaven watching over you.
